ai.title: AI provider
ai.description: Workspace-scoped. Cloud keys use OS keychain (BYOK). AI never auto-commits.
ai.saved: AI settings saved (key stays in OS keychain)

repoRules.suffix: ({{chars}} chars) is appended to every AI prompt for the active repo.

ai.ollamaNoModels: Ollama reachable but no models listed
ai.apiKeyKeep: API key (leave blank to keep existing)
ai.offlineMode: Offline mode — disable all cloud AI calls (Ollama still allowed)

fallback.label: Fallback providers
fallback.hint: Tried in order when the provider above fails with a network error. Cloud entries need their own API key (stored per provider in the OS keychain).

templates.hint: Each field replaces the built-in system prompt for that task — the diff, conflict sides, and repo context are appended automatically. Leave empty to use the built-in default. Per-repo rules (
templates.hintTail: ) are added on top of whichever prompt runs.
templates.commitPlaceholder: Override the built-in commit-message system prompt
templates.conflictPlaceholder: Override the built-in conflict-explanation system prompt
templates.prPlaceholder: System prompt for AI PR description generation
